title: Review stable depth orbit outputs
objective: Review Builder changes that stabilize orbit depth visualization, add raw metric depth .npy frames, add viridis PNG frames, and update depth videos/docs/tests. Confirm root-cause fix, output paths, backwards compatibility, and focused validation.
instructions: Review examples/flashlight/run_orbit_collection.py, examples/flashlight/README.md, tests/test_orbit_collection_validation.py, and docs/running_our_example_applications.md for consistency.
Confirm raw depth .npy frames are written per frame under frames/depth_meters_npy and viridis PNGs under frames/depth_meters_viridis.
Confirm depth_meters_visualization.mp4 and depth_meters_viridis.mp4 are encoded from stable viridis frames, RGB output remains unchanged, and naming/backwards compatibility is acceptable.
Assess whether per-setting finite min/max normalization resolves flicker/all-black behavior and whether invalid/degenerate depth handling is reasonable.
Run focused non-simulator validation, including unit tests, py_compile, and any smoke checks useful for viridis/depth helpers.
Flag any durable docs drift, especially docs/running_our_example_applications.md if it still lists old depth output paths.
definition_of_done: Inspector result clearly says whether Git-master can commit or Builder must repair.
